Transfer to San Jorge and take the ferry to Ometepe. On arrival, visit Ojo de Agua, pools of clear water fed by a natural underground spring.

Overnight at Villa Colonial or Villa Paraiso; the final hotel and overnight location will be confirmed before booking. Meals: breakfast.
